name: Loose Ends
summary: Deleting a tag first wires it to the 3 places that use it: replace it, or snap the wires
about: Loose Ends is a safe delete for things other things depend on, like tags, categories or colours. Pressing the cross on a tag that is still in use draws glowing wires to every place that uses it and opens a warning that counts them. Replace and delete swings each wire over to the tag you pick, sends a pulse down it and flips the pills to the new name; Delete anyway snaps every wire in the middle and leaves the places with a crossed-out tag.
how: Press the cross on a tag; unused tags simply pop, used ones open the warning.
Wires show every place that still uses it, with an amber mark on each.
Pick a replacement and press Replace and delete, or Delete anyway, or Cancel (Escape).
Press Undo in the toast (or Ctrl+Z) to put the tag back everywhere it was.
